name: RecallHub Control Plane
rules: Appsmith calls only the NestJS RecallHubAPI datasource.
No n8n URL, database datasource, or domain table write is allowed.
No hidden domain defaults are set for project_code, repo_root, framework, version, paths, or config files.
Work item buttons are UI-gated by backend status, and backend remains the source of truth.
Admin reconcile is role-gated and requires a confirmation modal.
